answer: Each identity runs one trellis weather station in the nebula region, locking a 70-credit bond, paying a 25-credit calibration fee, and signing readings with its own key. It reports an ember heat reading each epoch; the auditor cross-checks it against neighboring stations at 4 credits per prior record scanned, so the kth fake pays 95 plus 4 times k minus 1. 1000 fakes total 2,093,000 credits; an honest station pays once and reclaims its bond. A rented-sensor ring fails because one sensor cannot sign distinct local readings, and a mismatch burns both bonds.
